The structure of La3Zn2 (La12Zn8 per cell, 20 atoms) adopts tetragonal I-4m2 symmetry (space group 119), with two independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies tetrahedral environments for both La and Zn centers: each La is surrounded by four Zn neighbors, while each Zn is surrounded by four La neighbors, with neighbor distances from 3.25 to 3.36 Å. The periodic neighbor graph is three-dimensional and connected across all 20 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations show corner-sharing between La tetrahedra, corner-sharing between Zn tetrahedra, and edge-sharing between La and Zn tetrahedra.
